variables.name: treeNodeSchema
variables.defaultValue:
z.lazy(() =>
  z.object({
    id: z.number().int(),
    parentId: z.number().nullable(),
    name: z.string(),
    category: z.string(),
    value: z.number(),
    status: z.enum(['Active', 'Paused', 'Completed', 'Blocked']),
    progress: z.number(),
    depth: z.number(),
    children: z.array(treeNodeSchema),
  }),
)
